title: A $1.1 trillion Pentagon budget plan sets up a fight on Capitol Hill - Breaking Defense
html:
Senate appropriators’ latest defense spending proposal puts billions of dollars behind Golden Dome, drone initiatives and munitions, while maintaining a roughly $1 trillion base budget. To make room for those investments, appropriators are proposing reductions to shipbuilding, F-35 procurement and research spending.

In this episode of The Congressional Roundup, Breaking Defense Editor-in-Chief Aaron Mehta explores the winners and losers in the appropriators’ plan, and looks ahead to the defense budget battles awaiting Congress during its lame-duck session.
summary: Senate appropriators are prioritizing Golden Dome, drones and munitions, but other military programs could pay the price.
